exercises.question: Which sentence expresses contrast?
options: Aunque son diferentes, tienen algo en común. [Although they are different, they have something in common.]
Las dos tradiciones son muy parecidas entre sí. [The two traditions are very similar to each other.]
Esta fiesta es tan importante como la otra. [This celebration is as important as the other one.]

exercises.english: The two cultures have some similarities.
Although they are different, they have something in common.

sentences: Sin embargo, tienen algo en común. [However, they have something in common.]
Aunque son diferentes, tienen algo en común. [Although they are different, they have something in common.]

exercises.question: Which word means «difference»?
options: diferencia [difference]
semejanza [similarity]
perspectiva [perspective]

exercises.sentence: Hay una gran ___ entre las dos tradiciones.
exercises.english: There is a big difference between the two traditions.
The two traditions are different but have something in common.

exercises.sentence: Aunque son diferentes, tienen algo en común.
options: Although they are different, they have something in common.
Because they are identical, they have nothing in common.
They are different and unrelated.

exercises.sentence: Las dos tradiciones son diferentes pero tienen algo en común.
options: The two traditions are different but have something in common.
The two traditions are exactly the same in every way.
The two traditions are different and have no connection at all.

exercises.sentence: Las dos culturas tienen algunas semejanzas.
exercises.english: The two cultures have some similarities.

options: No, son diferentes, pero tienen algo en común. [No, they are different, but they have something in common.]
No, son diferentes, pero tienen nada en común. [No, they are different, but they have nothing in common.]
Sí, son diferentes, pero tienen algo en común. [Yes, they are different, but they have something in common.]
Tienen valores parecidos. [They have similar values.]
Aunque son diferentes, pero tienen valores parecidos. [Although they are different, but they have similar values.]
Tienen valores parecida. [They have similar values.]
Son diferentes, pero también tienen semejanzas. [They are different, but they also have similarities.]
Son diferentes, porque también tienen semejanzas. [They are different, because they also have similarities.]
Son diferentes, pero también son semejanzas. [They are different, but they are also similarities.]

template.prompt: Say that the two practices are different but have similar values.
template.answer: Las dos prácticas son diferentes, pero tienen valores parecidos.

template.prompt: Give one similarity (the value of the family) and one difference (the way of celebrating it).
template.answer: Una semejanza es el valor de la familia; una diferencia es la forma de celebrarla.

template.prompt: Say that comparing cultures lets us find similarities and differences without deciding which is better.
template.answer: Comparar culturas permite encontrar semejanzas y diferencias sin decidir cuál es mejor.
